Subject: Redwood Inference — Pilot discussion / next steps

Alex — thanks again for the conversation today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

- Goal: evaluate Redwood inference to reduce per-token cost and hit a 99th-pct latency target for the customer-facing summarization feature (target: <= 250ms p95).
- Scope: 6-week pilot focused on 10k monthly active users and ~1.5k concurrent small requests at peak. We'll provide a sandbox dataset (anonymized logs) and API keys for the pilot.
- Success metrics: p95 latency, tokens/unit cost, and quality measured on the 200-case prompt set we discussed.
- Proposed timeline: pilot kickoff week of 6/23, 2 weeks for onboarding + config, 4 weeks of evaluation.
- Next steps: I'll attach a draft SOW and standard MSA for your legal review. Can you confirm who from your side should be looped in for legal/procurement?

Attachments: Draft_MSA_Redwood_v1.pdf (pdf stub), Pilot_SOW_Acme_Redwood.docx (docx stub)

If that all looks right, I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff for 6/24 or 6/25.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
